verses.text: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,

segments.text: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side,

verses.text: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;

segments.text: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side,
When men rose up against us;

verses.text: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us:

segments.text: Then they had swallowed us up alive,
When their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;

segments.text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us,
The stream had gone over our soul;

verses.text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

segments.text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

segments.text: Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

segments.text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers:
The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.text: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

segments.text: Our help is in the name of Jehovah,

headings.text: A Song of Ascents; of David.
